summary: Find the unique cell unit with a different inner pattern, scale up that pattern fractally, and overlay it at matching cell unit positions.
src: the unique 3x3 cell unit with a different inner color pattern s
dst: cell unit positions in the grid where the scaled pattern overlays d
match_cond: s.inner_pattern scaled up where each pixel becomes a cell unit, positioned so s overlaps with some existing cell units of same pattern type
transform: scale s.inner_pattern by cell_unit_size, place at d, non-overlapping cells overwrite original grid
multi_step: Step 1: identify repeating 3x3 cell units forming the grid pattern; Step 2: find the unique cell unit with a different inner pattern; Step 3: extract the inner pixel pattern of the unique unit; Step 4: scale pattern up so each pixel maps to one cell unit; Step 5: position scaled pattern so it aligns with the unique unit location; Step 6: overlay scaled pattern, non-matching cells overwrite background
notes: Fractal self-similarity approach - the unique anomalous cell unit contains a miniature pattern that gets scaled up to cell-unit level and overlaid on the grid
